## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results, and explain any relevant check you
could not run. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the expected checks.

## Rendering and performance

For visible changes, attach before/after screenshots and name the backend and
GPU. For changes on a measured path, link updated results under
`docs/performance/`. Remove this section when it does not apply.
